People value their relationships more, as they spend quality time together, breaking fast and supporting each other. 2. **Spirituality and Faith**: Increased focus on prayer, Quran reading, and seeking forgiveness deepens spiritual connections. This makes individuals prioritize their faith and spiritual growth. 3. **Empathy and Compassion**: Fasting instills empathy, especially towards those less fortunate.
